cd /tmp && rm -rf smoke-rotate && d=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$d" && mkdir dest && for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000 20260104-000000; do echo "$s" > "dest/app-$s.tar.gz"; (cd dest && shasum -a 256 "app-$s.tar.gz" > "app-$s.tar.gz.sha256"); done
R=/Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakfp17-d
echo '--- dry-run with = syntax (keep 1, newest survives) ---'
bash "$R/rotate.sh" -n --dest="$d/dest" --name=app --keep=1
echo "rc=$? remaining=$(ls "$d/dest" | grep -c 'app.*tar.gz$')"
echo '--- positional-after--- and -q ---'
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --keep 2 -q --dest "$d/dest" --name app; echo "rc=$? remaining=$(ls "$d/dest" | grep -c 'app.*tar.gz$')"
echo '--- help exits 0 ---'
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --help >/dev/null; echo "rotate rc=$?"; bash "$R/verify.sh" -h >/dev/null; echo "verify rc=$?"
echo '--- bad usage paths ---'
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --dest "$d/dest" --name app --keep x 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --dest "$d/dest" 2>&1 | tail -1; 
bash "$R/verify.sh" --dest 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"
bash "$R/verify.sh" --bogus --dest "$d/dest" 2>&1 | tail -1
bash "$R/verify.sh" --dest "$d/nosuch" 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --dest "$d/dest" --name app extra 2>&1 | tail -1
echo '--- binary-mode sidecar (shasum -b) with spaces in name ---'
rm -rf b && mkdir b && echo hi > "b/my data-20260101-000000.tar.gz" && (cd b && shasum -ba 256 "my data-20260101-000000.tar.gz" > "my data-20260101-000000.tar.gz.sha256") && cat "b/my data-20260101-000000.tar.gz.sha256"
bash "$R/verify.sh" --dest "$d/b"; echo "rc=$?"
echo '--- no sidecars ---'
rm -rf e && mkdir e && bash "$R/verify.sh" --dest "$d/e"; echo "rc=$?"
tool_input.description: Smoke-test rotate.sh and verify.sh flags, error paths, binary-mode sidecar
Check existing smoke script file in /tmp

result:
Done. Summary of the work:

**Bug 1 — `rotate.sh`**: `surplus()` used `tail -n +"$keep"`, which returns the *newest* lines of the oldest-first sorted list — so it deleted the wrong (newest) archives, including one when exactly N existed. Fixed to delete the oldest `total - keep` entries (`head -n`, guarded for the zero case since BSD `head` rejects `-n 0`).

**Bug 2 — `verify.sh`**: the sidecar's file name was extracted with `awk '{print $2}'`, truncating at the first space (`my backup-…` → `my` → "archive missing" → BAD). Now split with `read -r expected file` so the remainder keeps its spaces, and the `*` binary-mode marker from `shasum -b` is stripped.

**Refactor**: new `lib/common.sh` holds the shared option-parsing block (with its double-sourcing guard, like `lib/log.sh`) and `resolve_dir`; `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` define `usage`/`parse_local_option` and source it. `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` untouched.

**Tests**: added a space-in-name verify test and a rotate group (exactly-N keeps everything; `--keep 2` deletes only the oldest plus its sidecar). `bash tests/run_tests.sh` — all 12 tests pass.

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, new `lib/common.sh`.
